issues.note: The ar field holds text in the other language here; it sits in that language's slot as heading, with wording and word order untouched, so nothing is translated or reordered.

layout.note: All 9 sources are placed once, in order: 34 output rows, 31 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 34 code points at the median, inside the manual-v1 range. No crossed pairings, no orphaned one-word heading rows and no detached section labels were left behind. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.
